channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Useful SCP "Items"?" - Ive been wondering how many of them exist

item.title: Re: Useful SCP "Items"?
item.content:encoded: Another good place to look would be the "foundation-made" tag. Although most of these stories end up not so beneficial as originally intended.

item.title: Re: Useful SCP "Items"?
item.content:encoded: Generally, a lot of stuff that's useful to the Foundation is tagged 'Thaumiel' (and indeed, has an object class of thaumiel); not everything that's useful fits into that definition but it's a good place to look if you're wondering what kinda things have been done there.

item.title: Useful SCP "Items"?
item.content:encoded: So, ive been wondering lately, how many SCP "Items" that are useful to the foundation exist (e.g. SCP-714, SCP-500)
